note: 十段中英编稿；未配音，未发布，不预填时间轴。设计记录包含固定职责、隔离恢复和审批边界。

series.title: 清理脚本误删：停任务、隔离恢复与边界保护
series.premise: 制品清理任务报告候选路径越界，生产制品读取出现缺失；先阻止继续删除，再确认实际影响。
series.outcome: 空租户参数使路径退到共享父目录，确认三个制品缺失；隔离恢复并校验后受控切回，修复参数和路径边界，批准小范围重启，保留审计证据与停止开关。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

phraseDefinitions.zh: 提前拒绝危险输入的保护分支
路径限定在授权目录内
单次允许删除的数量上限
验证拒绝异常输入的测试用例

recycling.note: 未来候选安排，非实际出现；当前复现只依赖p001-p350或本稿早段。

dialogues.title: 清理结果异常
dialogues.premise: 任务报告越界候选，同时出现制品缺失请求。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分删除告警、实际缺失与尚未确认的范围。

lines.en: We've got an unexpected deletion alert. The candidate list includes another tenant's directory.
lines.zh: 出现非预期删除告警，候选清单包含另一租户目录。

lines.en: Is that a preview or actual execution? We need to stop further writes.
lines.zh: 这是预览还是实际执行？必须阻止继续写入。

lines.en: Three artifact reads return missing files. That suggests actual impact, not just preview.
lines.zh: 三个制品读取报告文件缺失，说明可能有实际影响，不只是预览。

lines.en: Okay, I'll take point on this. Just to confirm, cleanup is running, right?
lines.zh: 好，我来协调。确认一下，清理任务还在运行，对吧？

lines.en: The dashboard lags behind process state. Check the host, not just the panel.
lines.zh: 面板滞后于进程状态，查主机，不只看面板。

lines.en: Let me tail the log safely. I'll copy it before changing anything.
lines.zh: 我先安全查看日志，做任何修改前复制日志。

lines.en: Don't rerun the script for diagnosis. That could remove additional files.
lines.zh: 不要为诊断重跑脚本，可能继续删除文件。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis is a boundary failure. Maybe an empty tenant argument explains it.
lines.zh: 目前假设是目录边界失守，可能与空租户参数有关。

lines.en: That's plausible, but not established yet. Preserve the invocation and effective environment.
lines.zh: 有可能，但尚未证实。保留调用参数与实际环境。

lines.en: Those reported paths define the initial scope. That's our blast radius so far.
lines.zh: 先按报告路径圈定范围，目前影响范围就是这些路径。

dialogues.title: 调度停了不等于进程停了
dialogues.premise: 清理任务可能仍在执行，先控制新增删除。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出停止调度、运行进程和重试队列是三项检查。

lines.en: Okay, disable the scheduler under emergency approval. Stop this run and queued retries too.
lines.zh: 好，按应急授权停调度，也停止当前执行和排队重试。

lines.en: Disabling scheduling won't stop existing child processes. I'll check their process group directly.
lines.zh: 停调度不会停已有子进程，我直接检查进程组。

lines.en: I'm on it for queued retries. Just to confirm, no automatic restart, right?
lines.zh: 排队重试我来停。确认一下，不自动重启，对吧？

lines.en: Record the stop command and timestamp. We'll compare them with deletion events.
lines.zh: 记录停止命令和时间，之后与删除事件对照。

lines.en: I'll suspend cleanup's scoped storage credentials. Reads use a separate identity and continue.
lines.zh: 我暂停清理任务专用存储凭据；读取用独立身份，继续提供服务。

lines.en: That should buy us time safely. What's the ETA for process confirmation?
lines.zh: 这样能安全争取时间，确认进程停止预计多久？

lines.en: The parent and children have exited. No delete requests remain in flight.
lines.zh: 父子进程均已退出，没有仍在执行的删除请求。

lines.en: Good, keep an eye on audit events. About five minutes of observation first.
lines.zh: 好，继续关注审计事件，先观察大约五分钟。

lines.en: No new deletion events since the stop. That supports containment, not complete recovery.
lines.zh: 停止后没有新增删除事件，这支持已控制扩散，不代表恢复完成。

lines.en: Right, affected reads are still missing data. We'll scope those before any restore.
lines.zh: 是，受影响读取仍缺数据，恢复前先圈定它们。

dialogues.title: 按记录确认缺失
dialogues.premise: 进程和重试均停止，清理凭据暂停，开始核对删除记录。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别候选路径与实际删除，理解清单可能不完整。

lines.en: The deletion manifest lists twelve attempted removals. Only three paths belong outside the tenant.
lines.zh: 删除清单记录十二次尝试，其中三条路径属于租户范围之外。

lines.en: Attempted doesn't mean successfully removed. Match return codes with storage audit records.
lines.zh: 尝试不等于删除成功，要把返回码与存储审计核对。

lines.en: Three shared artifacts are actually missing. That's our blast radius based on reconciliation.
lines.zh: 核对确认三个共享制品确实缺失，这是当前已证实的影响范围。

lines.en: Just to confirm, inventories agree, right? Could buffered logs hide another deletion?
lines.zh: 确认一下，清单核对一致，对吧？缓冲日志会不会漏掉删除？

lines.en: They could, so check authoritative object inventory. Don't rely on the script log alone.
lines.zh: 可能，所以查权威对象清单，不能只依赖脚本日志。

lines.en: I'm on it with the inventory comparison. What's the ETA for customer mapping?
lines.zh: 清单对比我来做，关联到用户预计多久？

lines.en: The inventory confirms those three missing objects. Other tenant inventories match their prior snapshots.
lines.zh: 清单确认这三个缺失对象，其他租户与此前快照一致。

lines.en: About two minutes for consumer mapping. We can rule that out as fleet-wide deletion.
lines.zh: 关联使用方大约两分钟，可以排除全体制品被删除。

lines.en: Within the inspected storage scope, yes. Keep that qualification in the incident update.
lines.zh: 在已检查的存储范围内可以，事件更新保留这个限定。

lines.en: Okay, publish the confirmed scope only. We'll list unverified areas separately for follow-up.
lines.zh: 好，只公布确认范围，未验证区域单独列出跟进。

dialogues.title: 恢复之前保留现场
dialogues.premise: 确认三个共享制品缺失，需要留存证据再恢复。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出只读副本、访问控制与不覆盖现场的理由。

lines.en: Let's preserve the evidence before restoring. Just to confirm, copies are read-only, right?
lines.zh: 恢复前保留证据。确认一下，副本是只读的，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, with hashes and restricted access. The originals stay under the incident hold.
lines.zh: 是，记录哈希并限制访问，原件按事件要求保留。

lines.en: Let me tail the log copy. The invocation shows an empty tenant value.
lines.zh: 我看日志副本，调用参数显示租户值为空。

lines.en: I'll preserve the object inventory as well. It captures what's missing before recovery.
lines.zh: 我也保留对象清单，记录恢复前缺失的内容。

lines.en: Keep the exact script revision and environment. Current source might differ from execution.
lines.zh: 保留实际执行的脚本版本和环境，当前源码可能已不同。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis now has supporting evidence. But the root cause is still open.
lines.zh: 当前假设有了证据支持，但根因还没确认。

lines.en: The preserved revision includes its dependencies too. We can reproduce behavior without live storage.
lines.zh: 保存版本也包含依赖，可以不接生产存储复现行为。

lines.en: Okay, one action item for access control. Anika owns the evidence retention decision.
lines.zh: 好，证据访问控制列为行动项，Anika负责保留期限决策。

lines.en: Exclude credentials from the shared incident notes. Store sensitive evidence in the restricted location.
lines.zh: 共享事件记录不包含凭据，敏感证据放受限位置。

lines.en: Agreed, maybe legal retention also applies here. I'll check before releasing any evidence hold.
lines.zh: 同意，可能还涉及法务保留要求，解除保留前我会确认。

dialogues.title: 空值为什么落到父目录
dialogues.premise: 已保存实际参数与版本，在无生产访问的环境复现。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解字符串前缀检查不足以建立目录边界。

lines.en: An empty path component selects the parent. The offline fixture reproduces all three candidates.
lines.zh: 空路径组成项使路径退到父目录，离线用例复现了三条越界候选。

lines.en: Does the safety check compare string prefixes? Sibling directories can share those prefixes.
lines.zh: 安全检查比较的是字符串前缀吗？兄弟目录可能有相同前缀。

lines.en: Yes, that's the second boundary weakness. Just to confirm, both checks need replacing, right?
lines.zh: 是，这是第二个边界缺陷。确认一下，两处检查都要替换，对吧？

lines.en: The deletion manifest matches that fixture output. No extra live run is needed now.
lines.zh: 删除清单与用例输出一致，现在无需再跑生产。

lines.en: Test resolved paths, not textual resemblance. Include sibling names and links escaping outward.
lines.zh: 测解析后的路径，不看文本相似性，覆盖兄弟目录和向外的链接。

lines.en: Okay, preserve the evidence from this reproduction. Our working hypothesis is now much stronger.
lines.zh: 好，保留这次复现证据，当前假设更有依据了。

lines.en: Path checks alone can't prevent concurrent replacement. The deletion mechanism needs race protection too.
lines.zh: 路径检查不能单独防止并发替换，删除机制也需要防竞态。

lines.en: We can rule that out for this run. The captured tree had no changing links.
lines.zh: 本次执行可以排除这种竞态，保存的目录树没有变化的链接。

lines.en: That's evidence about this incident only. It doesn't remove the broader safety requirement.
lines.zh: 这只是本次事件的证据，不能取消更广泛的安全要求。

lines.en: Agreed, maybe the guard needs two layers. Reject bad inputs and constrain filesystem access.
lines.zh: 同意，保护可能需要两层：拒绝错误输入并限制文件系统访问。

dialogues.title: 先在隔离区恢复
dialogues.premise: 离线复现支持路径条件缺陷，清理仍停用，恢复三个制品。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清校验、切回审批和不覆盖新数据的约束。

lines.en: We'll restore into isolation from verified backups. No overwrite of current objects is planned.
lines.zh: 用已验证备份恢复到隔离区，不覆盖当前对象。

lines.en: Check artifact signatures and recorded checksums. Also confirm the versions requested by consumers.
lines.zh: 核对制品签名、记录的校验和，以及使用方请求的版本。

lines.en: Just to confirm, writes stay isolated, right? Consumer switching needs my separate approval.
lines.zh: 确认一下，恢复写入仍隔离，对吧？使用方切换另需我审批。

lines.en: I'm on it for the version mapping. What's the ETA for isolated verification?
lines.zh: 版本映射我来做，隔离验证预计多久？

lines.en: Define a rollback trigger before switching. Signature mismatch means stop without serving replacements.
lines.zh: 切换前定义回退条件，签名不匹配就停止，不能提供替代制品。

lines.en: About ten minutes for all three artifacts. This temporary workaround doesn't re-enable the cleanup.
lines.zh: 三个制品大约十分钟，这个临时恢复措施不会重新启用清理。

lines.en: The signatures and versions now match. Test consumers read successfully from the isolated store.
lines.zh: 签名和版本现在都匹配，测试使用方能从隔离存储正常读取。

lines.en: Okay, approve the controlled read-path switch. Keep the previous routing record for reversal.
lines.zh: 好，批准受控切换读取路径，保留原路由记录以便反向切换。

lines.en: The switch succeeded for affected consumers. Leave the cleanup identity suspended during repair.
lines.zh: 受影响使用方切换成功，修复期间保持清理身份停用。

lines.en: Reads are healthy on the restored versions. We'll watch for any remaining missing references.
lines.zh: 恢复版本读取正常，继续观察是否还有缺失引用。

dialogues.title: 拒绝空输入并限制权限
dialogues.premise: 制品读取恢复，清理仍停用，开始修复危险输入与访问边界。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解输入检查、目录范围和最小权限各自的作用。

lines.en: The guard clause rejects missing tenant values. An empty path component now fails closed.
lines.zh: 保护分支拒绝缺失的租户值，空路径项现在会直接拒绝执行。

lines.en: That protects inputs, not every filesystem race. Use constrained directory handles for deletion too.
lines.zh: 这保护输入，不解决所有文件系统竞态；删除还要用受约束的目录句柄。

lines.en: I'll narrow the identity to tenant storage. Shared artifact directories won't grant deletion rights.
lines.zh: 我把身份权限收敛到租户存储，共享制品目录不授予删除权限。

lines.en: Just to confirm, links are rejected, right? We're not silently following external targets.
lines.zh: 确认一下，链接会被拒绝，对吧？不能悄悄跟随外部目标。

lines.en: Yes, and replacement races need explicit tests. A static path check isn't enough.
lines.zh: 是，并发替换竞态要专门测试，静态路径检查不够。

lines.en: I'm on it with the handle-based implementation. Maybe we'll need a platform-specific helper.
lines.zh: 目录句柄实现我来做，可能需要平台专用辅助函数。

lines.en: Review that helper before production use. Unsupported platforms must refuse deletion rather than fallback.
lines.zh: 生产使用前审查辅助函数，不支持的平台拒绝删除，不能降级到不安全实现。

lines.en: Okay, make that an explicit action item. Hannah owns verification, Raj owns the implementation.
lines.zh: 好，列成明确行动项，Hannah负责验证，Raj负责实现。

lines.en: I'll preserve the evidence alongside test results. Reviewers can trace each protection to failure.
lines.zh: 我会把证据与测试结果一起保留，让评审能对应保护与故障。

lines.en: Good, cleanup permissions stay suspended for now. Code approval alone won't unlock production access.
lines.zh: 好，清理权限暂时继续停用，代码通过不代表生产权限自动恢复。

dialogues.title: 不只测正常目录
dialogues.premise: 保护实现完成待验收，用隔离目录验证失败路径。
dialogues.listeningTask: 识别空值、兄弟目录、链接和竞态四类边界测试。

lines.en: Path containment tests reject sibling directories. Empty values and external links fail too.
lines.zh: 路径边界测试拒绝兄弟目录，空值和外部链接也失败。

lines.en: The guard clause logs the rejected reason. Just to confirm, no deletion follows, right?
lines.zh: 保护分支记录拒绝原因，确认一下，之后不会删除，对吧？

lines.en: Correct, including during simulated directory replacement. The constrained handle doesn't escape its root.
lines.zh: 对，模拟目录替换时也一样，受约束句柄不会逃出根目录。

lines.en: Okay, dry-run it first with realistic inventory. That checks selection without touching live objects.
lines.zh: 好，先用真实形态清单预演，只检查选择结果，不碰生产对象。

lines.en: Dry runs don't prove deletion safety alone. The isolated execution tests provide that evidence.
lines.zh: 仅预演不能证明删除安全，需要隔离执行测试提供证据。

lines.en: Both modes selected the same allowed candidates. We can rule that out as preview drift.
lines.zh: 两种模式选择相同的允许候选，可以排除预览与执行选择不一致。

lines.en: Keep an eye on rejection counts too. Unexpected refusals could reveal another input problem.
lines.zh: 也关注拒绝计数，意外拒绝可能揭示另一种输入问题。

lines.en: The review also checks maximum deletion count. Safety shouldn't depend on directory boundaries alone.
lines.zh: 评审也检查最大删除数量，安全不能只依赖目录边界。

lines.en: Maybe ten candidates is enough for canary. We'll propose that limit with the evidence.
lines.zh: 灰度可能十个候选就够，提交这个上限并附证据。

lines.en: Agreed, no restart until that review passes. Today's successful tests aren't permission by themselves.
lines.zh: 同意，评审通过前不重启，今天测试成功本身不是授权。

dialogues.title: 审批后小范围恢复清理
dialogues.premise: 边界测试和审查通过，申请限定租户的小规模重启。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住删除上限、审批与重新停止的触发条件。

lines.en: Approve a deletion budget of ten objects. One tenant only, with scoped credentials restored.
lines.zh: 批准最多删除十个对象，只一个租户，恢复限定凭据。

lines.en: Keep the stop switch within reach. An unexpected path is a rollback trigger.
lines.zh: 保留可立即使用的停止开关，意外路径就是回退触发条件。

lines.en: Just to confirm, stop means disable the scheduler, right? And terminate the active process group.
lines.zh: 确认一下，停止包括禁用调度，对吧？还要终止活动进程组。

lines.en: Yes, revoke cleanup access if needed too. Existing consumer reads use their separate identity.
lines.zh: 对，必要时也撤销清理访问，读取仍用独立身份。

lines.en: The deletion manifest matches approved candidates exactly. No shared artifact path appears in execution.
lines.zh: 删除清单与批准候选完全一致，执行中没有共享制品路径。

lines.en: Okay, actual removals stay below the budget. Rejected candidates remain untouched in this run.
lines.zh: 好，实际删除量未超上限，被拒绝候选本次未受影响。

lines.en: Reads remain healthy through the canary. Let's keep it under observation before expansion.
lines.zh: 灰度期间读取正常，扩大前继续观察。

lines.en: Maybe we'll expand tomorrow after another review. No automatic fleet-wide catch-up run tonight.
lines.zh: 可能明天再评审后扩大，今晚不自动全量补跑。

lines.en: Record both denied and successful operations. We need evidence that the limits actually applied.
lines.zh: 记录拒绝和成功操作，证明限制确实生效。

lines.en: Agreed, backups and recovery routing stay available. We'll retain the incident hold until closure.
lines.zh: 同意，备份和恢复路由继续可用，事件关闭前保留证据。

dialogues.title: 补齐拒绝路径测试
dialogues.premise: 小范围恢复清理成功，回顾空参数如何通过测试与评审。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区别直接根因、测试缺口与尚待查证的流程原因。

lines.en: We lacked a negative test case. Fixtures always supplied a valid tenant identifier.
lines.zh: 此前缺少异常输入拒绝测试，用例始终传合法租户标识。

lines.en: The reproduction establishes the direct path failure. Why review missed it still needs investigation.
lines.zh: 复现确认直接路径故障，评审为什么漏掉仍需调查。

lines.en: Okay, just to recap, reads are restored. Cleanup remains limited to the approved tenant.
lines.zh: 好，小结：读取已恢复，清理仍限于批准租户。

lines.en: The guard clause covers missing arguments, right? Path containment also covers valid but unsafe paths.
lines.zh: 保护分支覆盖缺失参数，对吧？路径边界保护也覆盖有值但危险的路径。

lines.en: Yes, plus scoped permissions and race protection. Don't collapse those layers into one checkbox.
lines.zh: 对，还包括限定权限和防竞态，不能把这些合并成一项勾选。

lines.en: One action item is mutation-based safety testing. I'll prove disabled guards make tests fail.
lines.zh: 一个行动项是变异测试，我会验证关掉保护后测试确实失败。

lines.en: I'll review that evidence before closure. Passing tests need to detect broken safeguards.
lines.zh: 关闭事件前我审查证据，通过的测试必须能发现保护失效。

lines.en: Maybe we should sample other cleanup tools. Let's close the loop on this one first.
lines.zh: 可能还该抽查其他清理工具，先把本次整改闭环。

lines.en: Assign a deadline for the review investigation. Recovery success doesn't explain the approval gap.
lines.zh: 为评审缺口调查定期限，恢复成功不等于解释了审批漏项。

lines.en: I'll bring the evidence next Tuesday. Expansion stays blocked until the checks are signed off.
lines.zh: 我下周二带证据回来，检查正式验收前不扩大清理。
